currentPage.description: The page number we are currently on (required)

endCursor.description: Cursor pointing to the last record on the current page

hasNextPage.description: An indicator whether there is a page after this one in the resultset based on current position

hasPrevPage.description: An indicator whether there is a page before this one in the resultset based on current position

startCursor.description: Cursor pointing to the first record on the current page

totalPages.description: The number of pages in the complete resultset based on the current length of the page (required)

totalRecords.description: Describes the total number of records in the complete resultset (required)

localAddress.description: Local address used for this peer session, if known from oper

operStatus.description: True when the BGP session to this peer is operationally up (e.g. established)

peerAsn.description: Peer ASN from oper, if reported

remoteAddress.description: Peer address from device oper state (IPv4/IPv6; may include IPv6 zone id)

state.description: BGP FSM state for this peer session

defaultOriginate.description: Set when default route needs to be advertised in BGP domain

maxPrefix.description: Maximum number of prefixes that can be received from neighbor

multiHop.description: Set when EBGP multi-hop functionality is enabled

sendCommunity.description: Flag for sending standard, extended, and large communities

key.description: Shared secret for OSPFv2 MD5 authentication on this interface

keyId.description: Identifier of the OSPFv2 MD5 authentication key configured on this interface

cakCryptographicAlgorithm.description: The cryptographic algorithm for the CAK, SAK Cipher Suite is implicitly selected based on this field. (required)

useXpnForCipherSuite.description: Whether to use XPN for the cipher suite. If true, AES_128_GCM_XPN or AES_256_GCM_XPN is selected based on the cmac algorithm. If false, AES_128_GCM or AES_256_GCM is selected based on the cmac algorithm.

lagMemberInterfaceId.description: The interface ID (required for when each lag member has a different MACsec configuration - when split_sak_config_by_lag_member is true) (required)
